meta.title: Buyer submits the award proposal into an approval workflow

plan.title: Submit Award Proposal to Approval Workflow

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded proposal where the Note for Approval is already completed.

args.goal: Click the top-right Submit Proposal, select the appropriate configured approval workflow, review the proposal details including line items, values and type, add closing remarks if needed, scroll to verify the full approval chain, click the bottom-right Submit Proposal, and stop on the Approval Screen showing the generated note for approval, event overview, allocation details, and the full approval chain.

steps.note: Execute and verify the proposal submission workflow on the buyer's current screen.
Assert that the buyer reached the approval screen after submission.
